|translation='''Title:''' Anakin's Lightsaber.

'''Card text:''' Deploy without spending Force on a Skywalker with ability > 3. Add 1 to Force drains at the location where the character is. Use without spending Force. Target a character. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > ability, the character is hit and the target's forfeit becomes 0.

'''Lore:''' A lightsaber made by Anakin Skywalker. Obi-Wan kept it in order to hand it over to Luke.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese states the Force-drain bonus and the free weapon use in separate sentences. The foil writes オビ＝ワン where the Hoth Japanese printing writes オビーワン.
|notes='''Anakin's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Anakin's Lightsaber|Anakin's Lightsaber]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Anakin's Lightsaber (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R98 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 32, Reflections III foil cards, R98.
